title: Packtrix manifest
description: OfflineRepository describes which machines an offline environment runs and which packages they need. Packtrix turns it into one signed repository per target.

Auth.description: Auth holds credentials for an upstream repository. Secrets are always references, never literal values.

clientCert.description: ClientCert and ClientKey are paths to a TLS client certificate.

clientKey.description: ClientCert and ClientKey are paths to a TLS client certificate.

entitlement.description: Entitlement is the directory holding RHEL subscription certificates, usually /etc/pki/entitlement.

password.description: Username and Password are sent with basic authentication. Password is a secret reference: "env:NAME" or "file:/path".

token.description: Token is sent as a bearer token. It is a secret reference: "env:NAME" or "file:/path".

username.description: Username and Password are sent with basic authentication. Password is a secret reference: "env:NAME" or "file:/path".

AutoRepos.description: AutoRepos controls automatic detection of built-in vendor repositories.

deny.description: Deny lists repositories never to add automatically, as glob patterns, e.g. "epel-*".

Distro.description: Distro selects a built-in distribution. In YAML it is either a name ("ubuntu-24.04") or an object that changes the distribution's defaults.

oneOf.description: A built-in distribution: packtrix catalog list shows them.

auth.description: Auth holds credentials for distributions that need them, such as RHEL.

components.description: Components selects parts of the distribution, e.g. [main, universe] or [baseos, appstream, crb]. Defaults depend on the distribution.

mirror.description: Mirror replaces the official servers, e.g. with a Nexus or Artifactory proxy. Paths and keys stay the same.

name.description: Name is the built-in distribution, e.g. "ubuntu-24.04".

Export.description: Export controls how bundles are written.

splitSize.description: SplitSize splits bundles into parts of this size, e.g. "4GiB".

OfflineRepositorySpec.description: OfflineRepositorySpec is the desired content of the offline repositories.

autoRepos.description: AutoRepos controls automatic detection of built-in vendor repositories.

export.description: Export controls how bundles are written.

packages.description: Packages are written once and resolved, with dependencies, for every target they apply to.

publish.description: Publish controls where and how repositories are written.

targets.description: Targets are the kinds of machines to build repositories for.

updates.description: Updates controls how upstream updates are picked up.

Package.description: Package is one entry of the package list. In YAML it is either a name ("curl") or an object.

deb.description: Deb and RPM are the real package names for one format, when they differ from Name.

except.description: Except applies the package to every target but these.

name.description: Name is the package name. When Deb or RPM is set, it is only a label.

only.description: Only limits the package to these targets. Values are target names, or "deb"/"rpm" for every target of that format.

repo.description: Repo takes the package from this built-in vendor repository instead of the distribution, e.g. "nginx-org".

rpm.description: Deb and RPM are the real package names for one format, when they differ from Name.

version.description: Version constrains the version, e.g. "1.34.*". It also selects the repository of vendors that publish one repository per version.

Publish.description: Publish controls where and how repositories are written.

keepSnapshots.description: KeepSnapshots is the number of earlier snapshots kept for rollback. Defaults to 3.

path.description: Path is the output directory. Defaults to "./repos".

Repository.description: Repository is a repository that isn't part of the built-in catalog.

auth.description: Auth holds credentials, when the repository needs them.

components.description: Components is required for apt repositories that aren't flat.

gpgKey.description: GPGKey is the path to the repository's public signing key.

name.description: Name identifies the repository in plans, locks and paths.

suite.description: Suite is required for apt repositories, e.g. "stable", or "/" for a flat repository.

type.description: Type is the repository's package format: "apt" or "rpm".

url.description: URL is the repository's base URL. {arch} is replaced with the architecture's native name.

alternatives.description: Alternatives picks "first" (default) or "all" branches of APT "a | b" dependencies.

baseline.description: Baseline is what machines are assumed to have already: "minimal" (default), "none", or "lock:<path>" for a discovered host.

exclude.description: Exclude lists packages never to download.

recommends.description: Recommends includes APT Recommends and RPM weak dependencies.

Signing.description: Signing configures the key that signs published repository metadata.

key.description: Key references the OpenPGP private key: "env:NAME" reads an environment variable, and "file:/path" a file.

Target.description: Target is one kind of machine: a distribution, a release and one or more architectures. Exactly one of Distro or Repos must be set.

distro.description: Distro is a built-in distribution, e.g. "ubuntu-24.04".

extraRepos.description: ExtraRepos are your own repositories, added on top of Distro.

name.description: Name identifies the target in only/except and in output paths. Defaults to the distro name.

repos.description: Repos is the complete repository list of a distribution Packtrix doesn't know. Vendor repositories aren't detected for these targets.

Updates.description: Updates controls how upstream updates are picked up.

check.description: Check is a cron expression for scheduled update checks. Empty means updates are checked manually.

minAge.description: MinAge is how long a new version must have been published before it is taken, e.g. "72h".

publish.description: Publish is "approval" (default: stop after plan) or "auto".
